meta.description: Minecraft server network focused on survival

landing.long_description: Build amazing structures, interact with players, and survive in worlds with unique game modes designed specifically for NightWorlds

banner.description: A Minecraft SMP. Moderated multilingual community. Stable and performant.

build.title: Build amazing stuff
build.description: The server rules are designed to allow players to build anything they want. You can build a statue, a futurisic city or café – we don't mind. The main rule is not to grief.

communicate.title: Communicate with other players
communicate.description: One of the main priorities of NightWorlds is people. This rule works in all of NightWorlds. Together, we can make anything possible!

simplicity.title: There's no sense to overcomplicate things
simplicity.description: We target minimalism. Simplicity is the real power! Here you won't see webpages with design like in 2007. Also, we don't show tons of text at one in the actual game.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Public offer, privacy policy, and other documents required for the provision of services
documents.subtitle: On this page, you can familiarize yourself with the documents (currently only in russian) that you may need while using the services of NightWorlds

footer.description: Minecraft servers, focused on survival. Equal player rights.

signin.title: Sign In
signin.description: Log in to your account to gain access to the full functionality of the NightWorlds website and game servers
signin.subtitle: We are currently based in Russia. Russia made third-party authorization with foreign services illegal. And passwords are insecure. The most safe way to sign in now is Telegram.

blessing.medium_player_notice: You see this page because you are a Medium player
blessing.title: NWm Blessing
blessing.description: Solve weekly tasks and get mana, which can be randomly converted to rare items and perks
blessing.agreement_disclaimer: This system is inspired by gambling mechanics. If you have or suspect you have a gambling addiction, <bold>do not proceed</bold> and seek help. By continuing, you confirm you are aware of the risks and are participating responsibly.
